contracts: DataflowExecution exposes a fact-erased execution service. Registry subclass validation proves execution capability, never DataflowAnalysis[Fact].
DataflowAnalysis[Fact] directly runs WorklistSolver[Fact] under its own fact parameter. Domain operations and iteration order are unchanged.

Existing injected/plugin solve services execute only through a finite dynamic boundary; their returned pair and BaseBlock mapping keys are checked without copying maps or facts. Opaque facts are not asserted to have an arbitrary generic type.

Public results remains the actual dict. Last-run and per-scope aliases reference the same underlying incoming/outgoing maps, including compact lazy views and ordinary mutable dicts. clear_results replaces owned containers and leaves retained observer objects intact.
Closure independently validates variable-name entry facts, preserves compact fallback/retention and explicitly injected solver selection.
Standard Analysis and Solver subclass hooks now delegate to super before registering the unchanged class name; PEP695 classes receive actual Generic initialization.

limits: Generic driver subscription remains compatibility syntax; published facts are explicitly opaque.
Unmodified liveness/reaching-definition/compact implementation modules retain their own preexisting debt and are not declared strict.
External solver fact contents are opaque; capability validation is not a semantic proof of an external solver.
